meta.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
meta.description: In a dystopia riddled with corruption and cybernetic implants, a talented but reckless street kid strives to become a mercenary outlaw — an edgerunner.

videos.title: Let You Down
videos.overview: After a night of streaming illegal braindance, David wakes up to reality: a rundown apartment with a broken washing machine and an overworked mother.

videos.title: Like a Boy
videos.overview: With his newly enhanced body, David heads to the Academy seeking revenge on his bully. Later, he meets a mysterious woman who wants to recruit him.

videos.title: Smooth Criminal
videos.overview: Surrounded by a group of rowdy edgerunners, David makes a plea to join their team. Meanwhile, sinister forces plot to lure him back to Arasaka Academy.

videos.title: Lucky You
videos.overview: Eager to learn the edgerunner ropes, David pesters Maine for another mission. Instead, Maine tasks Lucy with training him.

videos.title: All Eyez on Me
videos.overview: David makes a clever suggestion when the team strategizes for their next mission. However, he soon learns that their target can't be underestimated.

videos.title: Girl on Fire
videos.overview: Maine doesn't seem to be himself. But the team has bigger fish to fry: They must race against time to extract vital information from their prisoner.

videos.title: Stronger
videos.overview: Now an all-star edgerunner enhanced with more cybernetics, David leads his team into a new mission. An old contact reaches out to him for a big job.

videos.title: Stay
videos.overview: Faraday finds himself stuck between Arasaka and Militech. Lucy and Rebecca confront David about his change in behavior, but he refuses to listen.

videos.title: Humanity
videos.overview: Lucy's captors learn about her secret mission and dark past. David and his team head out to complete Faraday's job but realize that something is off.

videos.title: My Moon My Man
videos.overview: On the edge of cyberpsychosis but determined to save Lucy, David storms into Night City as Arasaka plots to deploy their ultimate lethal weapon.

videos.title: Last Chance for a Slow Dance
videos.overview: A former edgerunner slipping into cyberpsychosis and a lonely survivor with a fractured past start their stories at opposite ends of Night City.

videos.title: Give Me Another Day
videos.overview: A desperate call drags Weak back into danger to save a rebellious teen. As D bonds with a young cinephile, painful flashbacks fuel his thirst for revenge.
Weak tries to rescue Talia from a dangerous surgery, but the confrontation ends in disaster. D and Roman discover a chaotic chip that sparks mayhem.

videos.title: Someone That I Used to Know
videos.overview: Armed with abilities he doesn't fully understand, D uses Capri's power to infiltrate an Arasaka research facility. Talia and Weak find common ground.

videos.title: Fades (Pass the Distance)
videos.overview: An impulsive act sends Talia into a terrifying spiral. D's obsession with revenge reaches an unsettling new level of violence.

videos.title: Everything Hate
videos.overview: D becomes an anti-corporate vigilante and asks Roman to film his every move. Weak looks into rumors of tech that can transfer digitized consciousness.

videos.title: To the Depths with You
videos.overview: Talia's condition takes a startling turn under Capri's watch. D reconnects with an old friend. Weak and Avida chase a miracle cure.

videos.title: Serce
videos.overview: A riot ignites on the streets as D digs deeper into Project Capricorn's dark past. With time running out, Avida and Weak fight for Talia's future.

videos.title: Strictly Reserved for You
videos.overview: Omi and D go off the grid, and Kiril takes Talia into custody. Kyoko pushes Project Capricorn forward with frightening results.

videos.title: Then Everyone Went Home
videos.overview: A chilling transformation turns the city into a war zone, erupting in an explosive confrontation.
